`make linux-onboarding-test` drives the assembled native application against immutable v1.6.0 at `5202477edfe4b5d8bacfa5b2e9fd6eadd9624f7f`. The independent released collector verified all 77 imported production modules; their hashes remain in `released-application-onboarding.json`. Raw released observations have SHA-256 `16d02c9ed242205c134f319dd85ccfbbdf3c91b5536901ba8bdcee9e3361958e`. Temporary collectors and original PNGs remain outside maintained source in ignored scratch.

Eighteen complete states compare credential failure/retry, empty key entry, no download on selection, held/progress/completed provisioning, unsupported-language guidance, optional polishing/Skip, appearance, completed setup, recording/recognition, settings navigation and reopening. Saved and active settings, controls, History text, unchanged clipboard, actual artifact request count and absence of Codex turns are asserted independently. Default Qwen CPU runtime and both model files start absent in fresh private application state and are downloaded through the unmodified production HTTPS/hash/progress/cache path. A loopback HTTPS proxy streams the exact pinned public files, verifies host/path and records completed byte counts; it makes no outward connection. Model selection never starts a transfer, and held or incompatible readiness cannot advance setup.

The actual audio process supplies an existing public 16 kHz mono PCM clip to the production native worker. Real Qwen CPU recognition matches the released text in History. No speech HTTP request, rewrite turn or clipboard delivery occurs. Once CPU weights/runtime are ready, selecting missing CUDA runtime blocks Continue and restoring CPU enables it. Actual language dialogs select German and English. The polishing example is observed animating, then its displayed text/progress stop after Skip; reduced motion is independently compared in the released images. An actual review request after Skip preserves the recognized state without starting a provider.

Nine complete-window images are checked at the recorded 1060×780 GTK window size: seven full RGBA hashes match exactly, including the language modal. The authorized six-to-three model reduction removes only two slider tick marks in each of `download-held` and `local-ready`. Source/native differences are exactly `(398,374,1,6)` and `(672,374,1,6)` in the 1070×790 captured images. Only those twelve pixels are excluded; explicit image geometry and all remaining pixels match hashes computed from the released images. Full original/native images remain available. No complete image check is skipped.

This native route passes with both Python and uv blocked by positively exercised interpreter traps. It replaces the obsolete 153-line `onboarding_smoke.py` without retaining its patched downloader/readiness/keyring/private-step methods. `feedback_ui_smoke.py` and its helper remain for separate pane/revision/contraction contracts. The existing provider forms still own failed final saves, catalog/key errors and other wizard drafts.

The runner isolates display, network/PID/mount namespaces, devices, HOME/XDG, clipboard, accessibility and buses. The HTTPS certificate and synthetic keyring are private and disposable. Input artifact caches are read-only; production workers, artifact server and application owners are stopped and reaped. GTK 4.22.4, Pango 1.58.2, scale 1 and reduced motion are recorded. This proves one wide first-run CPU workflow and same-process setup reopening, not separate-process persistence, physical microphone/CUDA, live Wayland, every scale, final installation/upgrade or complete application parity. The HTTPS peer is a development example excluded from shipped binaries; the verified installed app remains 1.6.0.

```sh
MLUVA_TEST_ONBOARDING_ASSETS=/path/to/verified-public-artifacts make linux-onboarding-test
```

The artifact directory must contain the pinned `llama-b11011-bin-ubuntu-x64.tar.gz`, `Qwen3-ASR-1.7B-Q4_0.gguf`, `mmproj-Qwen3-ASR-1.7B-Q8_0.gguf` and the independently hashed `speech.wav`. Missing inputs fail before launch; there is no automatic public download or paid fallback in the checker.

The sibling assembled application passes fifteen workflows/147 states and native command/settings checks; provider forms pass 290 states. Final `make linux-test` passes 139 tests, zero failures and 68 ignored checks, both strict Clippy configurations, formatting and generated consistency. The remaining Python gate passes 571 tests plus Ruff/formatting for 149 files. Changed-shell ShellCheck and diff checks pass. Evidence is `tmp/native-onboarding-final-traps.log`, `tmp/native-onboarding-siblings.log`, `tmp/native-onboarding-final-native-clean.log` and `tmp/native-onboarding-final-python.log`.
